scope: Actual CPU synthetic checks executed before freezing the collector; this report does not claim a full 1601-image B0 model evaluation or any shadow ground truth.

execution.test_mode: Temporary Python scripts executed through the designated environment; temporary fixture directories removed automatically

tested_threshold_inputs: Temporary low/high threshold JSON fixtures. The real 8000-image fitted thresholds were not required to establish the synthetic expected values.

checks.description: Native 2x8 RGB/GT fixture with five classes and ignore255; collector CM checked against an independently specified matrix.

GT sky and ignore255 excluded, predicted sky retained. A GT-sky pixel predicted crater does not enter the conditioned crater FP count. Sky recall/IoU and its zero-denominator destination row are null; terrain-to-sky errors remain in CM.

Dark crater recall/IoU and crater-to-regolith destination fraction each equal 1/3 in the hand fixture; complete fixed-domain CM supplies FP. Every reported destination uses its true-class row denominator.
Shared brightness_groups with thresholds equal to fixture luminance values puts exact low in medium and exact high in bright. Dark+medium+bright CMs sum exactly to the all-terrain hand CM.

Controlled luminance/std maps test inclusive Y<=0.02 and std31<=0.005, nearblack/flat/intersection counts, and dark-flat plus dark-textured partition. This is a numerical mask check, not a claim about real shadow labels.
Final frozen implementation with actual raw-RGB and local_std helpers: constant-black 4x4 GT-rock image gives 16 nearblack-and-flat terrain pixels, rock IoU=1 and exactly 16 diagonal rock CM entries.
Saved L-mode class-ID prediction PNG compared pixel-for-pixel to the input prediction. CSV parsed with the expected row count and checked for LF line endings.

One 16x16 image contains 128 dark and 128 bright GT crater pixels; dark recall=0.5 and bright recall=1.0. Global and source-scene summaries have support_images=1, mean=median=-0.5 and the expected GT pixel totals. Sky has no eligible paired images.
Four real RGB/GT synthetic fixtures populate one image per requested panel group, with unique source IDs and the mountain-rock GT mixed tag. Dark-correct eligibility uses only GT classes1/2/3.

Direct deterministic panel-statistic fixture has 22 sources in a higher-score scene and 3 in another scene. First four selections alternate scenes A/B/A/B. Group counts are 10/10/5/0, with 25 distinct sources and no filler.
Replay the saved panel under changed predictions. Group/source order and baseline selection statistics remain unchanged; current statistics are recorded separately.
A fixture containing only GT sky and ignore255 produces zero terrain pixels, null mIoU/all class recalls and zero selected panel images.
Incomplete consumption of supplied validation records and a reread-GT/scored-target mismatch both raise ValueError.

Existing baseline_snapshot.json and b0.pt are allowed. Existing collector result files and existing prediction PNG are rejected. A rejected existing-PNG update leaves aggregate image count/rows unchanged; after removing the temporary conflicting fixture, retry gives the correct single-image CM.

limitations: No real model inference, GPU update, complete validation pass, model improvement or causal shadow conclusion is established by these checks.
Probability maps are not retained for all validation images; the separately implemented fixed-panel replay is responsible for continuous probability artifacts.
Boundary gating used explicitly controlled maps in addition to a constant-image check with the actual local standard-deviation helper.
